name: Nagoya University
description: Nagoya University is a national research university in Nagoya, founded in 1939 as the last of Japan's imperial universities. It runs English-taught Global 30 (G30) undergraduate and graduate programmes.
whyIncluded: Nagoya University is among the 10 universities in Japan most chosen by international students (2,034 international students in May 2025 per JASSO, with English-taught G30 programmes), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

livingCosts.summary: Nagoya University's own estimated monthly budget for an off-campus apartment in Nagoya: rent, utilities, food, phone, insurance and personal spending, 12 months a year. Nagoya gives no transport figure, so that is the national survey average for the Chubu region.
livingCosts.notes: Rung A. Nagoya University 'Living costs' admissions page, 'Monthly living expenses' estimate (undated, read 2026-10-08; page says 'for reference only'): housing = off-campus apartment 30,000-50,000 (midpoint 40,000) + utilities 10,000 = 50,000 (university accommodation is 42,000 including utilities); food 30,000; personal = telecommunications 5,000 + insurance 1,500 (National Health Insurance) + other personal expenses 10,000 = 16,500. The page's own total is 86,500-106,500. Nagoya lists no commuting/transport line, so transport = JASSO Lifestyle Survey of Privately Financed International Students, Chubu region average commuting cost 3,000/month (table 7-4 of the FY2021 report, studyinjapan.go.jp/ja/_mt/2023/12/Seikatsu2021.pdf; the FY2023 report's regional breakdown table could not be read in this session, only its regional housing average, Chubu 30,000, which is consistent with Nagoya's rent range). Tuition (535,800/yr) excluded.

programmes.name: School of Engineering, G30 Automotive Engineering Program (Mechanical Engineering)
programmes.summary: Standard national-university tuition, the same for all students. The one-off ¥282,000 is the admission fee, paid once in year 1. Fees may be revised during your studies. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: English-taught Global 30 (G30) programme, listed on the G30 admissions statistics page. An Electrical, Electronic and Information Engineering track is also offered. G30 'Tuition' page: tuition ¥535,800 per academic year regardless of nationality (the same as for Japanese students); non-refundable registration fee ¥282,000 at admission; application fee (¥10,000 undergraduate / ¥20,000 graduate) excluded. The page gives no year; national-university fees may be revised during enrolment, so not cohort-locked. No year-specific 2024/2025 figure read, so no history.
